integrity: A proof based on coarea, a convexity endpoint lemma and Fourier-slice uniqueness. Finite symbolic checking is not an infinite proof; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Euclidean unit balls, real functions, convexity on full (-1,1) in almost every direction; no extension to arbitrary convex bodies or individual-admissible-function classification.
title: The sharp integrability phase boundary for convex Radon sinograms on Euclidean balls
